title: Adaptive suggestion staging, audit trail, and reversible apply for batching & caching
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: Customers run the Optimize advisor and get batching/caching suggestions but lack a low-friction path to rehearse, audit, and safely commit those changes. Without a clear rehearsal and immutable audit trail, platform teams hesitate to adopt recommendations in production.

Goal: Ship a console workflow that lets users: 1) preview diffs for recommended batching and KV cache configs in a 'rehearsal' sandbox, 2) run a lightweight simulation against historical traffic to estimate token savings and latency impact, 3) apply changes via a reversible, staged rollout with automatic canary checks, and 4) have a searchable, immutable apply history with forensic details for audits.

Scope: Console UI for recommendation cards and rehearse/apply flow, backend endpoints for simulation runs and snapshot-based applies, and an audit trail feature that records inputs, simulation results, who applied, and rollback operations. Not in scope: automatic runtime-level kernel selection (handled by ENG runtime teams) and private deployment KMS integrations (separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation card shows estimated daily token savings, expected p90 latency delta, confidence score (0-100), and risk band (low/medium/high)

Rehearsal sandbox can run a simulated 24h traffic replay (configurable short window) and returns an estimated cost delta and error rate change within 30s for small samples and within 5m for full sample
Diff preview modal shows exact config changes in plaintext (old vs new), per-route impact summary, and a side-by-side sample response check to detect functional regressions
Apply flow supports staged rollout: canary percentages (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%), automated rollback if canary error rate or latency exceeds thresholds, and manual override
Apply operation creates an immutable audit entry with timestamp, actor, recommendation id, simulation snapshot id, git-like diff, and live metrics snapshot link
Rollback from the audit entry restores the prior snapshot atomically and records the rollback reason and actor
All simulation and apply operations are idempotent; repeated requests with same replay_id produce the same simulation result
UX accessible for keyboard users and meets basic a11y color contrast for risk badges
design_notes: Card layout: compact title row, key metrics row (savings, latency, confidence), action row with Rehearse / Inspect / Apply buttons
Risk badge color palette: green (#1F8A3E) low, amber (#D9822B) medium, red (#C92A2A) high — use same palette across Optimize panels
Diff preview: use monospaced block, highlight changed lines, include inline tooltip for technical terms (KV TTL, batch_size, prefix_cache_ttl)
Rehearsal modal shows a progress bar, estimated time, and a quick 'sample' toggle to run a 1h sample instead of full replay
Audit timeline: vertical event stream with snapshots; allow filtering by actor, recommendation id, route, and time range
Mobile: collapse metrics into a horizontal scroller on small screens, keep primary actions reachable with thumb
Design mocks: initial draft in Figma -> link in links
engineering_notes: New API endpoints: POST /optimize/replay (starts simulation), GET /optimize/replay/{id} (status/results), POST /optimize/apply (creates snapshot and starts staged rollout), POST /optimize/rollback/{apply_id}
Database: add optimize_snapshots table (id TEXT PK, recommendation_id TEXT, config_json TEXT, created_by TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP, sample_metrics JSON stored as string), keep entries immutable
Idempotency: use replay_id and apply_id client-supplied UUIDs to make operations repeat-safe
Canary runner: leverage existing deployment orchestration in ENG-88712; implement policy adapter that accepts thresholds and triggers rollback via control-plane events
Observability: emit events to console-traces with tags (recommendation_id, user_id, replay_id, apply_id) and add a dashboard panel to monitor ongoing rehearsals and rollouts
Simulation performance: allow short-circuit path that uses cached prefix/KV statistics when full replay cannot run (fall back to heuristic estimator)
Security: ensure apply and rollback endpoints require 'optimize.apply' IAM scope; log actor identity in audit entries
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal dogfood): enable for internal accounts only, train SEs and have 2-week feedback loop. Phase 2 (gradual public opt-in): enable for 10% of production customers with recommended defaults and telemetry. Phase 3: full GA with docs and migration guide. Rollout guarded by telemetry thresholds; automatic rollback disabled for first two days after GA for extra safety.
testing_notes: Unit tests for diff generation and snapshot creation
End-to-end tests using synthetic replay traffic (small/medium/large) to validate simulation estimates vs ground truth
Chaos test: simulate slow simulation worker and verify front-end shows graceful timeout and retry
Security test: RBAC asserts for apply/rollback endpoints and pen-test checklist for audit tampering
Manual UX review with PM, Design, and two external customers during dogfood
